dedupe_keys.name: eu list of its national access points for transport data european commission

description: This European Commission page lists the ITS National Access Points that Member States set up to ease access, exchange and reuse of transport data for EU-wide interoperable travel and traffic services. It explains that the list shows the state of deployment within the delegated acts of Directive 2010/40/EU, including Regulation 885/2013 on information services for safe and secure truck parking and Regulation 886/2013 on road safety-related minimum universal traffic information, among others, and that it aims to connect those involved in research, development and provision of such services. Coverage: EU Member States and associated countries. Format and access: a public web list linking to each national point. Licence and cost: free; each point has its own terms. Caveats: links and responsiveness vary; several national points did not answer from the cloud on 2026-09-29. It supports network flow and emergency response studies that need official traffic and travel data across Europe. It relates to the French, Spanish and Belgian access points, the European transport feeds list and DATEX II in the catalogue.
